candidateName.title: Candidate Name
candidateName.description: Part of the candidate name. Leave empty for any name.

includeCards.title: Include Cards
includeCards.description: True only when the recruiter's question needs details from the CVs. Limits the result to 8 candidates.

location.title: Location
location.description: Part of the city or country, for example Madrid. Leave empty for any location.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: How many candidates to return. Default 25, maximum 50. Leave empty unless the recruiter asks for a number.

minYears.title: Minimum Years
minYears.description: Minimum years of experience, for example 10 means 10 or more. Leave empty for any.

skill.title: Skill
skill.description: A skill the candidate must have, for example LWC. Leave empty for any skill.
